description: This file implements an in-memory lease provider for the Orleans framework, primarily used for local development and testing. It includes classes and interfaces for acquiring, releasing, and renewing leases, managing lease state in memory, and simulating lease loss scenarios.

classes.name: InMemoryLeaseProvider
classes.description: An implementation of ILeaseProvider that manages leases in memory for development and testing.

classes.name: DevelopmentLeaseProviderGrain
classes.description: A grain that stores lease information in memory, simulating lease management for Orleans.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire leases based on requests, returning success or failure.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Clears all lease data, simulating a lease state reset.
